items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: No, I know that he always, I know that he thought the world of him, that's all I know. We have now even talked about it.

ctx.x: Did Stacey in any way imitated Hines? Or just felt it?
No, I know that he always, I know that he thought the world of him, that's all I know. We have now even talked about it.

Sullivan doesn't show that immediate influence. Sullivan shows the vitality without the figuration being so nearly identical. And then of course there have been the Stacey disciples after that moment.
